doc: Increment-5 coverage set (diw/PRODUCT_DESIGN.md section 8, 'Coverage set'). Frozen in stage 1 with the HEAD 19d98828 build (shadow mode): slices whose blocks carry ;DIW:FB lines (sparse paths crossing a revert region) and slices with st=small blocks, which the increment-4 matrix does not reach. Meshes come from planner_meshes.py with --delta mesh_delta (the slot width depends on it); overrides go on top of profiles/flat_machine_diw.json + flat_process_powder.json (classic walls). Run with shadow_export.py --matrix --extra coverage_slices.json --only cov_ (kind COV checks 'expect', the counters need >= 2 FB slices and >= 1 small slice). 'expect' holds the counts measured at freeze time (blocks by st, FB lines, distinct k with FB). 'rejected' lists the candidates that reach FB but fail an increment-4 T2 check against v2 (kept out of the set, see PRODUCT_DESIGN.md Deviations).
